[[Hamri]] is a [[collector]], a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for weapons.

==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]
**{{NPC location|Yatendi Canyons}}

==Dialogue==
:''"The word through the grapevine is [[Shashi]] requires your services. That boastful sack of spittle is always trying to one up my every move. When I showed him my stunning hat collection, I swear I saw a look of jealousy in his eyes. Next thing you know he starts strutting through town wearing a gilded rock beetle on his head as a fedora. He told everyone how he crafted this "exotic" topper out of "the rarest" of species. The nerve! Any idiot knows that those bugs multiply like...well, like insects! I suspect now he envies my prized hoard of talons. Who wouldn't? I mean, it's not like behemoth gravebane and cobalt shriekers just hands their claws over when you ask politely! Do me a favor, bring me 5 [[Cobalt Talon]]s so I can prove to that clammy windbag once and for all that he cannot compete with the likes of Hamri, and I'll give you:''"
